cad_reference.model_basis: The standard KiCad RT1 16A footprint itself references this eight-pin RT2-envelope model. All eight extracted pin centers agree with the footprint. It is a KiCad reference, NOT downloaded TE STEP.

transform.bottom_view_comparison: Mirror horizontal screen coordinate once when comparing a bottom-view drawing with the final top view. Do NOT copy bottom-view A1/A2 screen positions. Final top-view coil A1 left, A2 right; crop displayed A2 left, A1 right. Contact pairs are symmetric and keep the same function on both sides.
transform.cad_model_transform: center original STEP at (12.15,3.75,0), rotate Cartesian Z by -90 degrees. No reflection, no clipping. KiCad STEP Cartesian Y and board screen Y have opposite signs.

coordinate_limit: Nominal manufacturer pinning is 5 mm. Available KiCad reference contains 5.04 mm longitudinal steps and 7.5 mm row spacing; do not describe those library coordinates as independently verified exact TE dimensions. The former 2.54 mm perfboard approximation used 5.08 mm steps and 7.62 mm rows. Direct TE dimensional/tolerance check remains open before manufacturing.
routing: Join each duplicated contact pair; BAT+ to both COM11 contacts; both NO14 contacts to the existing parallel R1/R2 input. Do not connect COM to NO with copper, do not route any unproved C3209 pad, supply origin or INA polarity.
